tokens.name: bg-hover

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings, KPI values, table body text. 17.9:1 on bg-card (light), 15.9:1 (dark).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting copy, button labels on bg-input, branch names in progress rows. 7.6:1 on bg-card (light), 6.8:1 (dark).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Eyebrow labels, table headers, footnotes, kpi-sub. Clears 4.5:1 on every surface: light card 5.33, page 4.82, subtle 5.09, hover 4.76; dark card 5.69, page 6.30, hover 4.62.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline for cards, table header rule and panel edges. Structure, not a control boundary, so it stays quiet; controls use border-control.

tokens.name: border-soft
tokens.usage: Row separators inside tables and lists.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: THE accent, navy: active tab and nav marker, focus ring, links, primary button fill, default KPI rule. As text 11.2:1 on bg-card (light), 8.2:1 on the dark card. The app still names it --indigo (a legacy alias).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for primary buttons and active controls. on-accent reads 14.4:1 (light), 11.7:1 (dark) on it.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind accent text: neutral tags, preset chips, the selected row. accent reads 9.6:1 (light), 6.8:1 (dark) on it.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on an accent fill: white on navy (11.2:1); near-black on the light dark-mode accent (9.1:1). Never a literal white.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Edge of anything you can type in or press that has no fill: inputs, selects, secondary buttons, segment tracks. Meets 3:1 for control boundaries: 3.49 on white, 3.43 on the dark input.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Up / on-track: KPI top rule (kpi-up), progress fill, ontrack dot, alert-bullet rule, db-status dot. A fill, never text (2.54:1 on white) — text uses good-ink.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Down / off-track: KPI top rule (kpi-down), progress fill, alert-bullet rule. A fill, never text (3.76:1 on white) — text uses bad-ink.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Near target / needs a look: anomaly banner rule, progress 'near' fill, warn bullet rule.
